card.name: Assorted nouns ending a phrase
card.fires_on: Common nouns that end a short noun phrase, such as train, tea, specialist, kiosk, or the end of anemia and tea. The pattern is loose, with no single topic.

modes.label: Train words
modes.description: The word train used for rail travel in travel or memory writing.

modes.label: Drink or item names
modes.description: Names of drinks or items in a list, sometimes cut partway through the word.
modes.example: juice,<< tea>>, and other beverages will work as well

card.plain: It fires on various ordinary nouns, such as train, tea, and specialist, with no single theme.
